notes: One logical two-leg monthly gold/silver relative-flow-divergence package. Q02 must evaluate combined package PnL, costs, density, and correlation; neither leg is a standalone strategy.

The EA subtracts silver from gold separately across every synchronized completed prior-month close-to-open and open-to-close log return, trades only strict relative-component opposition, follows the session-relative sign, targets equal absolute notionals, and caps aggregate frozen-stop risk at one RISK_FIXED budget.
